title: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release
key_points: Godot 4.0 does not find .NET native DLLs that aren't in the directory the editor is installed in
.NET native DLLs must be copied into the Godot Editor's install directory or they will not be found when running in the Editor
This issue was resolved in Godot 3.5, where the DLLs can be found if they are in the output directory when running in the Editor
limitations: The scope of this issue list is limited to an undetermined Godot 4 release
The relevance and recency of the issues and pull requests listed cannot be determined without further context
asserts: In Godot 4, .NET native DLLs must be copied into the install directory of the Godot Editor or they will not be found when running in the Editor.
scope: This issue applies to Godot 4.x releases specifically and contrasts with the behavior observed in Godot 3.5
